Readline: A readable stream that reads input line by line, rendering an editable prompt line with cursor movement, history, and line-editing keys.
Readline.constructor: Create a `Readline` interface over an input and output stream.
Readline.clearLine: Clear the current input line from the output and reset the line buffer and cursor, returning the cleared line.
Readline.close: Stop listening for input and end the stream.
Readline.cursor: The current cursor position within the input line.
Readline.input: The readable stream that keystrokes are read from.
Readline.output: The writable stream that the prompt and line edits are rendered to.
Readline.prompt: Render the prompt and current input line to the output.
Readline.constants: Constants used by `Readline`, including the end-of-line sequence.
Readline.createInterface: Create a `Readline` interface over an input and output stream.
Readline.setPrompt: Set the prompt string written before the input line.
Readline.write: Write data directly to the output stream.
ReadlineOptions: Options accepted when constructing a `Readline` interface.
ReadlineOptions.crlfDelay: Milliseconds to wait after a carriage return before treating a following linefeed as part of the same line ending, rather than a second line. Clamped to a minimum of 100.
ReadlineOptions.input: The readable stream to read keystrokes from.
ReadlineOptions.output: The writable stream to render the prompt and line edits to.
ReadlineOptions.prompt: The prompt string written before the input line. Defaults to `'> '`.
ReadlineEvents.data: Emitted with each completed line, in addition to the line being pushed to the readable stream.
ReadlineEvents.history: Emitted with the updated history array whenever a new line is remembered.
ReadlineEvents.line: Emitted with each completed line, for Node.js `readline` compatibility.
